mapper.select: SELECT dp.id, dp.scheme_id AS schemeId, dp.version_id AS versionId, dp.item_config_id AS itemConfigId, dp.parameter_config_id AS parameterConfigId, dp.parameter_id AS parameterId, dp.data_point_id AS dataPointId, dp.name, dp.point_type AS pointType, dp.trend_line_config AS trendLineConfig, dp.options, dp.time_format AS timeFormat, dp.date_style AS dateStyle, dp.rounding_up AS roundingUp, dp.report_display AS reportDisplay, dp.record_id AS recordId, dp.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, dp.component_id AS componentId, dp.record_item_id AS recordItemId, dp.field_id AS fieldId, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lm_stability_scheme_judgment j WHERE j.is_deleted = 0 AND j.parameter_config_id = dp.parameter_config_id AND j.data_point_config_id = dp.id ) AS referencedByJudgment FROM lm_stability_scheme_data_point dp WHERE dp.parameter_config_id = #{parameterConfigId} AND dp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY dp.id ASC
